findings.title: F-35: `EvidencePlaneSecurityAuditTrail` is a legitimate persistence site, but its `CANONICAL_VALIDATING_PATH` classification rests on a composition assumption the code does not enforce
The "immutable, replicated" audit trail report is bookkeeping: deleting stored entries leaves `replicated=True, immutable=True` and nothing detects it
Audit trail `list_entries` returns the oldest 1000 entries only; secret-shaped values under benign keys are stored (re-verified P7-00 F-20)

Hardening has no production composition: signing, audit trail, strict-config validator, plugin provenance gate and the credential broker with its admission port have no non-test caller (re-verified P7-00 F-04)
Plugin provenance is bound to the operator mapping key, not to `attestation.distribution`, and the installed files are never hashed (re-verified P7-00 F-21)
TENANT-X carrier-count gate is red at this SHA (831 vs pinned 819); not covered by any earlier audit
The sandbox unit suite has a red governance-deny test, and the physical egress tests are skipped on this host
Tool-input guard is a four-regex heuristic with simple evasions; the middleware passes an empty `tool_id` and the default allow-list is empty (allow all)
Poisoning default differs by path: the plan-context path stays off in non-production mode when the profile is absent
Strict-config validator and signing wiring accept weak or disabled settings; strict mode on a lab profile is unchecked
A resource with no tenant is accessible to any scoped tenant; `RequestIdentity.tenant_id` is not normalised
The credential resolver keeps the provider exception, with its text, as `__cause__`
Security-defense plugin admission defaults to structural-only and `isolate` on load failure (a failed defense plugin is silently absent)
`raw_secret_gate` evasions (re-verified P7-00 F-30)
Lab profiles use the public demo seed implicitly; the seed is still importable (re-verified P7-00 F-23)
Satellite wording is stale or imprecise (link note, definition of "strict", coverage depth)
Both B-D6 implementation commits carry a forbidden AI `Co-Authored-By` trailer
`prod_q` pytest process does not exit after its summary
MCP exposure security not independently exercised (BLOCKED row, `fastmcp` absent)
R015 and R019 are proven for credentials, tool allow-list and three XD pairs, not for tenant data sent to a model provider or for all of D1-D8

routing: each finding is repaired in a D6 ticket by a session other than the implementer and the auditor; fresh auditor re-audits (loop 1 of 2)
